image_description: A high-angle close-up of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, grey rock surface. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow markings on its head, back, and limbs. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is broad, and the eyes are visible with a slight glint. The forelimbs and hindlimbs are splayed, showing short digits. The tail extends towards the right edge of the frame.
